contracts: (The report computes orphan_count equal to zero only when every atomic obligation has bidirectional coverage and required witnesses; otherwise validation fails.) AND (The structured result contains a non-success decision for the unexecuted case and an explicit unexecuted-case rejection reason.)

Each declared assertion needs a cer_assertion mapping and a meaningful independent oracle. Tests must invoke the real production entry. The plan is not a behavior observation. Keep governance/constraint failures non-authorizing; do not emit expected-red for them. Preserve all bound Given/When/Then and forbidden outcomes. No placeholder pass or synthetic RED.

selector_intents: A fixture or validator input marks a case unexecuted while the success decision is accepted; the semantic gate must fail.
An inventory fixture contains an atomic obligation with no covering witness or reverse edge; the integrity validator must report a nonzero orphan count.
